entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading strategy—Abstract, Overview, and Details—to achieve a 91% token reduction and significant task-completion gains.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform enables persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text, code, and conversations. It supports local extraction and embedding models without requiring LLM API keys to distill session lessons into searchable permanent memory.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It supports multi-modal extraction from diverse file types and maintains auto-updated user profiles with stable facts and recent activity.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain combines keyword retrieval, semantic search, and automated background enrichment to manage institutional memory. It exposes memory to agents via MCP on Tailscale tailnets, providing scoped access for team-based environments.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows through an LLM wrapper designed for disposition-aware response generation. It supports multiple programming languages and offers deployment options ranging from bare-metal to Kubernetes.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho serves as the core FastAPI-based library for building stateful agents, acting as the upstream foundation for self-hosted Hermes wrappers. It provides Python and TypeScript SDKs to facilitate integration across managed, local, and self-hosted environments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages memory as a git-like repository, utilizing a five-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM for sub-100ms performance. It features an interactive TUI and version control capabilities like branching and merging for markdown context trees.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance for Hermes Agents. It includes episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system utilizes local infrastructure including Qdrant and Redis to manage vector search and structured facts. It features an auto-curated wiki and a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts such as traces, playbooks, and context bundles. It provides tools for evidence-driven diagnosis and goal solving across Python, TypeScript, and MCP clients.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from persistent message histories.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from 34 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of past data. It automatically strips keys and tokens during indexing, allowing agents to search through months of previous interactions stored on disk.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private, cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using a Docker-based stack including PostgreSQL and Redis. It supports local inference servers and any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider to maintain persistence across different sessions.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur implements a shared memory layer that stores plain-text YAML engrams on local disk for multi-agent tool portability. It utilizes an MCP server integration to provide hybrid retrieval through BM25 and local embeddings.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI offers a local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses. It features real-time ingestion from GitHub, Discord, and Obsidian, achieving 97.6% answer accuracy in LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and agent hooks, employing a hybrid retrieval system that combines vector search with BM25.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema instead of vector databases or embeddings. The project includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and supports FTS5 search across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference while preserving accuracy.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result and tracking knowledge contradictions. It includes a self-directing loop that identifies knowledge gaps and ranks results by recency and canonicalization.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It utilizes a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis with citations and provenance, storing data in SQLite with rebuildable Markdown projections. It allows agents to autonomously recall and evolve persistent knowledge across sessions using portable archives.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd provides anticipatory memory by watching agent session logs to prefetch context into a local SQLite-vec cache. Built as an MCP-native server, it uses node-llama-cpp and GGUF models to manage memory for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets. It manages state and retrieval using a stack comprising SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to ensure agents only load necessary data. It features local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search with BM25 full-text ranking and graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tools from a schema. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents using hash-checked proposals and receipts for reviewed updates. It provides a source-neutral migration workflow for exporting chats and documents across supported agents.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with 1-10 importance rankings. It surfaces high-priority entries during prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and supports immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and handle x402 payments across multiple blockchain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys to facilitate autonomous financial transactions.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and scripts to provide agents with searchable capability routing. It supports neighbor traversal for knowledge retrieval and can automatically generate tool-OKF via detached model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-agent continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected sessions. It uses native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer for reliable caching and write outbox management.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking during retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories via a required local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing files, alongside LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This long-term memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management. It utilizes a hybrid search approach combining vector, BM25, and graph methods, and features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based memory hygiene system that uses a git-backed directory of markdown files instead of a database. It employs 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify contradictions and stale data, proposing evidence-cited diffs for review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology rooted in TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates implementation planning and spec elicitation while supporting various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime. It exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, and MP4 through a dedicated coding-agent CLI.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured security skills mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and D3FEND. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms and covers 34 distinct security domains.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It features a CLI and MCP server that support incremental synchronization while preserving manual layout changes.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router for protocol skills and adds a dedicated layer for verification and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It offers rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes with optional voice profiles for different professional tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos. It integrates with Hermes and Claude Code, providing a bilingual dashboard to inspect session traces and evolved skills.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state within the project's documentation folder to support Claude Code and other agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,166 professional skills across 35 vocations that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring telemetry or accounts. The MIT-licensed bundles are designed for direct export to assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via specialized slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It manages work, decisions, and evidence through a CLI-driven mechanism kernel.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides agentskills.io-compatible skills and guides for VPS production and automation in Portuguese. It supports integrations for communication platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable interactions with CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams. They are installable through the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. It offers specific prompting guidelines to optimize output across the FLUX 3 video suite.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant skills by linking instructions to specific file lines. It features automated workflows for briefing, creating, testing, and exporting these skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that operates via a Rust binary using four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It maintains local traces and verification journals for every run to ensure transparency.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills installable via a Python client or CLI with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for autonomous execution of long-running tasks, this skill provides real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It includes built-in rollback procedures to facilitate safe recovery during complex multi-step operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS via Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. it features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face, operating autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive scheduling and system design. It stores all data in a local SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across multiple surfaces like Discord, Telegram, and CLI, supporting 97 languages. It aims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite while evaluating prompt quality across five specific dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports five programming languages and includes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition, evidence-based verification gates, and systematic investigation protocols. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop failures during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and provides automatic registration for common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to address real exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations and detect state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for developing new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs covering token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy while offering optional incident alerts for Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts via vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding the final optimized file into a README.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, providing direct installation commands for discovered plugins. It integrates with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language and validates them against runtime-specific profiles to prevent configuration drift. It features CI-friendly exit codes and monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to ensure ongoing compatibility.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps and drafting structured improvements. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR on documents via macOS Vision, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed to assist with e-commerce material creation and structured data extraction from images and PDFs.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. it ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This library provides skills and blueprints for lead enrichment, social data access, and automated tasks like newsletter drafting. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and MCP, offering agents access to web scraping and workspace Postgres databases.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is built for compatibility with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties or hosting their own bounty boards. It operates over x402 without requiring accounts or API keys, utilizing user-defined price ceilings and dedicated wallet keys.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills through a hosted MCP server. It enables Hermes Agent to access structured web data across 31 different platforms.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansions with user interests while producing structured analysis that includes core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from major providers like OpenAI and Google. It serves as a specialized distribution layer for users who require reproducible development environments and automated package maintenance.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI interaction by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for mobile agent operations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. The setup supports shell command execution and interactive model configuration through both external providers and local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready CRD workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on high-security deployments by implementing hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing for granular security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and monitor Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative configuration of Hermes Agent deployments, including workspace documents and CLI settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure handling of secrets via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. The platform supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation, enabling the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework organizes specialized agents into a multi-tier structure of researchers, traders, and portfolio managers for financial analysis. It enables backtesting across various LLM providers and data vendors to evaluate fundamental, sentiment, and technical trading strategies.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a centralized Web UI or CLI. It supports multi-agent workflows with integrated memory browsing and can be deployed locally via Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution and Docker for sandboxed environments. Users can monitor agent activity and review code diffs through both TUI and web-based dashboards.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain while supporting the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features specialized detection for HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for infrastructure tasks such as security auditing, VPS provisioning, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework facilitates the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage agent team delegation and integrates with MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface provides a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent tasks. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure domains. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to handle local tools and communication throughout the automated task lifecycle.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent, referencing Arxiv research for its methodology. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while tracking candidate mutations and frontier progress.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to track performance metrics and GitHub star growth. It utilizes Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize code and scoreboard data.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It eliminates cloud dependencies by running parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing files. It includes an MCP server and automatically synchronizes the index on every file change to ensure data remains current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token consumption and costs across multiple AI agents, including Hermes. It features a 3D visualization dashboard and a TUI, allowing developers to monitor their usage via a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools. It redacts authentication headers for security and provides a self-contained HTML viewer for analyzing exported session traces.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, or specific project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers compatible with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting providers. It assists developers in building better user interfaces by integrating directly into the agent's workflow.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills to streamline building and shipping apps with Hermes Agent. It is designed for autonomous execution across both local laptops and remote VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. The tool provides control over ASCII art banners, spinners, and interface colors.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This project establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and integrates with various AI providers to facilitate browser automation workflows.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms like Telegram and Slack, as well as development environments like VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and finance, featuring automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic analysis of prompts, tool definitions, and agent configurations using HERM v1.1 scoring. It integrates into development workflows via GitHub Actions, pre-commit hooks, and SARIF output to validate Markdown, JSON, YAML, and Python files.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for local configurations and skills. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This setup tool provides automated installation of a hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It enables rapid deployment of 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost using free models.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and maps nested authentication structures to ensure a functional migration.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry. It utilizes zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift against config-aware baselines without cloud dependencies.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project provides a deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It enforces a security model requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions through specific contract structures.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: Hermes-voice adds a fully local, offline voice interface to Hermes Agent featuring wake-word activation and adaptive turn-taking. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a dedicated circuit breaker for API outages and provides specific tools for searching, adding, and deleting agent memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: Built with the Tauri 2 framework, this cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It centralizes configuration management for multiple agentic tools and CLI interfaces, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local open-source application facilitates autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access across various agent CLIs. It supports built-in and external agents like Hermes Agent and provides remote access through WebUI, Telegram, and other messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure connectivity through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion application simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard provides unified configuration for ten communication platforms, including WhatsApp and Matrix, across runtimes like Hermes and Claude Code. It features a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, PTY terminal, and a memory browser for managing agent skills. It supports a Swarm Mode that utilizes role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Available as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container, this collaborative workspace aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents. It supports fifteen built-in agents and custom ACP-compatible registrations, complemented by native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for system repair and shell access. It features an embedded terminal alongside native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat and memory management on both Windows and macOS.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It enables multi-agent profile switching and uses AI-assisted tab scoping to manage prompt context and synchronized histories.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: This native SwiftUI iPhone app pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details, file attachments, and private push notifications via an open-source relay.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code while providing custom LLM model routing. Users can monitor code writes and diffs in a live workspace while tracking token usage and latency via a runtime dashboard.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and scheduled cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that searches prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It tracks per-session token burn and API costs while allowing users to resume CLI sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this dashboard provides a text-based interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports task management through a kanban board and allows users to manage profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA functions as a Telegram Mini App, supporting terminal chat with file attachments and streaming responses. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to manage up to five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a built-in workflow engine and 100 tools for tasks including TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, MCP servers, and an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and supports model switching. It features a Visual Skill Store containing over 50 curated one-click installations.
